title: Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral Kit Automation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Specify protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired values for Number of Samples (1‑96), select the appropriate P300‑Multi generation, choose the mount for the P300‑Multi, and select the Magnetic Module generation in the protocol setup.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware JSON files (.json).

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the supplied deck map, placing tip racks, plates, magnetic module, and other labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P300‑Multi pipette; consult support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the Opentrons App to start the automated nucleic‑acid purification.
